en: Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, impinging, and without applied thought and sustained thought, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, non-impinging, with applied thought and sustained thought, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, impinging, and without applied thought but with sustained thought, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, non-impinging, and without applied thought but with sustained thought, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is visible, impinging, without applied thought, and without sustained thought, there arises a state that is visible, impinging, without applied thought, and without sustained thought, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are twenty-one; under object condition there are three ...
pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are twenty-one.
